checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One finished 16:9 thumbnail with a large, visibly tired-looking human face
must.why: Image is 640x384 (5:3), not 16:9. The left face is awake with glowing red eyes and the right is asleep. Two faces, neither clearly large or tired.

must.item: Headline relates to quitting scrolling or sleep
Headline high-contrast and readable at thumbnail size
Face and headline unobstructed, not awkwardly cropped
must.why: No headline. The faces are uncropped, but the left face is dark and the two characters look different.

faults.what: No headline text, so it fails the three-word headline requirement
Aspect ratio is about 5:3 rather than 16:9, and resolution is low at 640px
The left character has glowing red eyes, which look demonic or AI-made rather than tired; no phone is visible on the left
The two halves show different people (a dark-haired boy and a brown-haired woman), though the description says it is the same person
The faces are small within the frame, so they would not read at phone-thumbnail size

summary: The output is a nice split-scene illustration of an awake person and a sleeping person, but it has no headline, isn't true 16:9, and has no large, clearly tired face, so it isn't a finished thumbnail.
